record.field: Brand model linked to products with logo and website.

Create a module that adds a Product Brand model with the following fields: - name (required, unique) - logo (image) - website (URL) - description (text) - product_ids (one2many back-reference to product.template)
Add a brand_id Many2one field on product.template, with a smart button on the brand form showing the number of products. Include list, form, and kanban views, a top-level menu under Inventory, and ACL granting full access to internal users.
Simple library management: books, authors, borrowing.

Create a library management module with two models:
1. library.author — name, biography (text), birth_date, book_ids (one2many) 2. library.book — title, author_id (many2one, required), isbn, publication_year, state (Selection: available/borrowed/lost, default available), borrower_id (many2one res.partner), borrowed_date
Add buttons on the book form to "Borrow" (asks for borrower, sets state to borrowed, records date) and "Return" (clears borrower, sets state to available). Include list, form, search views with filters by state and grouping by author.
Personal task list with priority, deadlines, status.

Create a personal todo-list module with model x_todo.task: - name (required) - description (text) - priority (Selection: low/medium/high/urgent, default medium) - deadline (date) - state (Selection: draft/in_progress/done/cancelled, default draft) - user_id (many2one res.users, default current user)
Add a kanban view grouped by state with color coding by priority, a calendar view by deadline, and a search view with filters "My Tasks", "Overdue", "High Priority". Record rule: users see only their own tasks.

Create a module that extends res.partner with the following fields: - secondary_email (Char, with email-format validation) - preferred_contact_method (Selection: email/phone/sms/none) - loyalty_points (Integer, readonly, default 0) - date_first_contact (Date)
Add these as a new "Additional Info" tab on the partner form view. Include a search filter "VIP Partners" for partners with loyalty_points > 1000.
Add a custom field to Sale Orders.

Create a module that adds a "Project Reference" Char field to sale.order, displayed prominently next to the order name in the form view. The field should be optional but indexed for search. Add it as a column in the sale order list view (optional, hidden by default) and as a searchable field in the search view.
Add a hierarchical custom field to products.

Create a module that adds two fields to product.template: - material (Selection: plastic/metal/wood/glass/fabric/other) - recycled_percent (Float, between 0 and 100, with constraint)
Show both fields in a new "Sustainability" section of the product form. Add a search filter "Sustainable Products" matching recycled_percent >= 50.
QWeb PDF report summarising invoices by partner.

Create a QWeb PDF report for account.move (invoices) titled "Monthly Invoice Summary". The report should: - Accept a date range (start_date, end_date) via a wizard - Group invoices by partner, showing partner name, count, total amount - Display a grand total at the bottom - Be available from the Invoices menu under Print
Include the wizard model (transient), the report template, and the menu item.
Wizard to bulk-update a field on selected records.

Create a Server Action and wizard that lets users bulk-update the "customer rank" field on selected partners from the Contacts list view. The wizard should: - Accept new_rank (Integer) - Show how many partners will be affected - On confirm, write the new rank to all selected partners - Display a notification with the count of updated records
Use models.TransientModel for the wizard, an act_window record for the server action, and bind it to res.partner in the list view's Action menu.
Wizard to archive multiple records with a reason.

Create a wizard that archives selected records of res.partner with a recorded reason. The wizard should: - Accept a reason (Selection: duplicate/inactive/spam/other) - Accept an optional comment (text) - On confirm, set active=False on each selected partner and log a message in the partner's chatter with the reason and comment
Bind it to the partner list view via Action menu.
Public HTTP endpoint to receive webhooks, log them to a model.

Create a module that exposes a public HTTP controller at /webhook/inbound accepting POST requests with JSON body. Every incoming request should be logged to a new model x_webhook.log with fields: - received_at (Datetime, default now) - source_ip (Char) - payload (Text — full JSON dumped) - headers (Text — relevant headers)
Include list and form views (read-only on form), a menu entry under Settings → Technical, and admin-only access. The controller should always return JSON {"ok": true, "id": ...} with HTTP 200, even on malformed input.

Create a simple sales dashboard module. Add a TransientModel x_sales.dashboard with computed fields: - total_revenue_this_month (Monetary) - order_count_this_month (Integer) - avg_order_value (Monetary) - top_customer (Many2one res.partner)
Show as a form view with KPI-style large numbers in cards (use Bootstrap classes for layout). Accessible from a top-level Sales menu entry called "Dashboard".
Cron job that archives old inactive records.

Create a module with a scheduled action (ir.cron) that runs daily at 2am and archives any res.partner record where: - active = True - write_date is more than 365 days ago - has no related sale orders or invoices
The cron should be defined in XML data with active=True and a 1-day interval. Include a logger statement showing how many records were archived.
